I hope every American sees what the Democrats are doing when it comes to Border Patrol and ICE.

They would rather play politics than keep you safe.

Remember that in November.

Video

The President has been clear and consistent with Iran about his red lines.

I have full confidence President @realDonaldTrump will continue to act in America’s best interests as negotiations proceed.

Video

As Senate Budget Chairman, I’m making it a top priority to keep DHS funded through the reconciliation process.

We are well on our way to delivering yet another win for the President to the people.

Video

To those critiquing how the President is dealing with Iran: what have you done?

President @realDonaldTrump is the only man who has ever put action behind his words, and I’m with him 100%.

Video

Great meeting with @POTUS. 

The reconciliation train is on the tracks.

I wish Paul and his lovely family well.


The Post and Courier (@postandcourier)

Paul Dans, one of the authors of the Heritage Foundation’s Project 2025, has dropped his Republican Primary bid against sitting U.S. Senator Lindsey Graham in the upcoming June primaries. postandcourier.com/politics/…

Thank you for your support, President @realDonaldTrump. 

With your endorsement, I will not let the great people of South Carolina down!

Very interesting analysis.


The Free Press (@TheFP)

We now know who the U.S. is dealing with: a small team of mainly hard-liners who are determined not to capitulate, writes Eli Lake. thefp.com/p/meet-the-new-fac…




— https://nitter.net/TheFP/status/2042337064847352315#m

Instead of firing the staffer who posted this vile and antisemitic video, one of my opponents is proudly standing by him.

I’m speaking out because there is no room for this in the Republican party.

Video

We already have one Anti-Israel party: the Democrats.

South Carolina Republicans will not put up with this hatred any longer.

I will not stop fighting until the men and women who keep our country safe have the funding they need to continue getting the job done, without interference or delay from Washington.

President Trump has drawn clear lines in the sand and rightfully so. For too long, the Iranian regime threatened our safety. 

Thanks to @POTUS, that era will be over soon.

Video

President @realDonaldTrump understood what past leaders ignored: Iran can never be allowed to have a nuclear weapon.

Video

President @realDonaldTrump is right to have a red line when it comes to Iran enriching uranium. 

Iran has a proven history of cheating, and I’m proud our President is standing firm for our safety.

Video

Could not agree more, Mr. Vice President. 

I hope Iran is listening.
